measured: 2026-10-22, DeusEx.exe 1.112fm under Wine 11.17 on the Linux host (~/.wine-deusex, the shared Wine lock), driven by scripts/travel-probe.sh with the ini: step (scripts/travel-step.sh) over ad/scripts/original-game.mjs, which launches the game on INI=DeusEx-ad.ini USERINI=User-ad.ini (copies of the prefix's files: StartupFullscreen=False, WindowedViewportX/Y 1280x720, WindowedColorBits=32, CaptureMouse=False, the three Galaxy volumes 0, NumPad8/9 bindings) so the prefix's own DeusEx.ini and User.ini stay untouched. Menus were clicked with the mouse (dxinput click) in the 1280x720 viewport; each click was followed by 1.5 s before the files were copied. The captures are .work/config-persistence/wine/ (not in Git).
facts: A settings screen writes nothing until its OK: the ini files were byte-identical to the screen's start in all seven snapshots taken with its choices changed and OK not yet clicked (Sound, Display, Resolution only, Keyboard/Mouse, Controls, Game Options, Colors).

OK rewrites the file within the 1.5 s that followed it (SaveConfig -> Flush(0)); nothing is written at exit: DeusEx-ad.ini and User-ad.ini were byte-identical before and after `cmd exit` in both sessions.
A file is written whole, its sections and keys in the order they were read; a value changed in place keeps its slot, a key the file lacked is appended at the end of its section.
A file with no changed value is not rewritten: User-ad.ini kept its modification time through the Sound screen's OK, whose player.SaveConfig() changed nothing.
SetRes on its own (resolution choice only, OK) rewrites DeusEx.ini at once: UWindowsViewport::ResizeViewport ends in Client->SaveConfig() (WinDrv.dll 0x1110e35d).
At launch the game rewrote DeusEx-ad.ini once, WindowPositions WizardDialog only (the launcher's own window placement); User-ad.ini was not rewritten.

baseline.DeusEx.ini: the prefix's DeusEx.ini with the launcher's changes above
baseline.User.ini: the prefix's User.ini; session 2 with bAskedToTrain=False (DX_USER_SET)

launcherChanges.note: what ad/scripts/original-game.mjs writeIni changed in its copy of the prefix's DeusEx.ini before the launch (the validator applies them to the installed file)

firstSaveAppended.note: The keys, in order, that the original's earlier saves had added to the Wine prefix's User.ini (written 2026-09-09 by real play) and that the installed User.ini of this checkout lacks: the end of [DeusEx.DeusExPlayer], the end of [Engine.PlayerPawn], and [Engine.Pawn] after it. A first player.SaveConfig() appends them to a file that lacks them.
